title: The entry's Parts table shows Not Tracked for a location that does not count it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Have a part, part A, stocked at the test location and at location B under the same part number: tracked at the test location with 4 in its bin, and untracked at location B with 3 in its bin.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens and its Parts table lists two rows under Workplace: the test location and location B.
  • The test location's row reads 4.00 in the Remaining Quantity column.
  • Location B's row reads "Not Tracked" in the Remaining Quantity column, in place of its 3.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S11-R8: “On a Part Library entry's detail page, the parts table shows "Not Tracked" in the Remaining Quantity column for a row whose part is untracked at its location, in place of the quantity.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
